sequence: Implementation tests completed and ac17433 pushed before either hypothesis rerun started.
request: After implementing the conservative fixes, retry every earlier hypothesis, including those beyond the original stopping rule.
original_stop_rule_preserved: The original historical experiment stopped after three non-improvements. This separately requested rerun explicitly uses --all-hypotheses.

protocol.selection_no_match_rule: Do not exceed max(5%, baseline no-match injection on the same split). The 5% production release target is reported separately.
protocol.amendment: The baseline itself injects on 2 of 22 development negatives after adding hard controls. An initial absolute-5% selection rule made every additive hybrid variant inadmissible by construction; that pilot selected no candidate and automatically re-scored the baseline heldout set. No heldout outcomes informed the correction. Keep every control and require no false-positive regression for research selection. Subsequent runs replay the frozen policies to check reproducibility; they do not introduce new hypotheses after the third non-improvement.

hypotheses.description: Learned word-vector means recover conceptual matches absent from lexical candidates.
Corpus IDF weighting gives informative words more influence than common wording.
Removing the leading corpus component separates generic similarity from useful subject similarity.
Character n-gram similarity recovers morphology and partial identifiers missed by lexical admission.
Giving the canonical title four times its normal influence improves retrieval over verbose claim wording.
Routing through concise titles avoids dilution by procedural detail.

protocol.heldout_policy: Evaluate only the baseline and selected candidate after stopping; do not retune from held-out outcomes.
protocol.limitations: The existing held-out baseline was published previously. These are synthetic retrieval trials, not evidence of real agent task success or a production rollout authorization. Corpus documents are visible; held-out queries and labels are not used for selection.

protocol.request: Try the previously untested hypotheses from the uploaded proposal, after completion of the first three-failure experiment.
protocol.selection: Maximize development Recall@8 without increasing no-match injections above max(5%, baseline). Break threshold ties toward the higher threshold. Do not retune on validation.
protocol.validation_status: The existing heldout split was exposed by prior runs; this is a fixed validation check, not a fresh blind holdout.

hypotheses.test: Source-claim-bound contextual tags vs unchanged lexical/file retrieval.
Previously untested semantic-only ablation and contextual-keys-plus-hybrid combination, using the already-pinned real word-vector model.
Intent-only vs provided task-state file fields; an ablation of existing runtime information, not an oracle file-discovery result.
Claim-only vs source-linked context; constructed evidence-delivery fixture using the same source descriptors as H1.

Candidate Recall@32 vs Recall@8. A learned reranker is justified only if ranking losses are observed. Also test a cheap bi-encoder gate/reranker on 32 contextual lexical candidates, preserving exact-title and explicit-file matches. This is not a learned cross-encoder.
Top eight vs incident collapse on the same constructed admitted candidate pool, with two required independent facts and duplicate crowding.
Activity-only vs source-linked structured claims: capture presence and retrieval measured separately; automated extractor accuracy remains unmeasured.

protocol.amendment: After the first requested-proposal run, contextual keys reached higher recall but added a validation false positive for an unrelated meaning of compression. This exploratory follow-up adds a bi-encoder admission/reranking prototype; its threshold is selected on development only, but the hypothesis was informed by exposed validation results. No blind-generalization claim is made, and keys remain frozen.

encoder_cost.excludes: worker IPC, SQLite retrieval/indexing, model reply and 10000-record scale; these are in-process encoder measurements

limitations: The validation split was previously exposed, and descriptors were authored manually. This is a fixed replay, not a blind estimate.
The model is pooled spaCy word vectors, not a transformer sentence encoder or learned cross-encoder.
Activity/structure and crowding fixtures are constructed; automated capture and live-agent answer quality are not measured.
Runtime observed-file improvements are supported by scripted request regression tests, not attributed to synthetic flat retrieval scores.
The 30% baseline and selected-gate false-injection rate fails the 5% production target. Research gates remain disabled in production.
Title-only was attempted but cannot encode every identifier-only title with the pinned vocabulary; it is unavailable rather than a measured recall failure.
